text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh... seriously... Where even is 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have gone for an outdoor 
run... For now... maybe I'll check over 
that way...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What is this place...? Something 
feels... really off—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh, no no no no!! This place is 
totally baaaad!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Aaargh, what am I supposed to do here?! 
At least put up a sign or something!!"

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: —Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaahhh?! Wh-What the heck, brat?! 
What're you doing in a place like this?!?!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I wanna go home... I wanna go 
home... Back to my town... back to my 
house...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~!? *I'm* the one who wants to go 
home! B-But there's nothing I can do about 
it, alright!?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
It's so... lonely here... I wanna go 
home...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“...... Argh, seriously! This is why I 
hate selfish brats!”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hold on tight! If it's come to 
this, we've gotta go for it...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooooooh!! Right! Left! Up-diagonal! 
Down-diagonal!! Straiiiiiight ahead!!!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*, *pant*, *wheeze*... All 
right! A light! I made it back somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Big sis... thank you...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Praise me, shower me with praise, 
you bastards! Both my instincts and my 
running were sharper than ever!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
By the way, kid. Where's your house— 
H-Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? ...No, no, no, wait... whaaat?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although Espoir City never spoke of what 
happened upon her return— her running had 
become strangely more refined.
